newsitem.title: USA: Norwalk Savings sees Q4, FY96 rising.
newsitem.headline: Norwalk Savings sees Q4, FY96 rising.

text.p: Norwalk Savings Society said Friday that it expects fourth quarter and full-year net earnings "will significantly exceed those of the prior year."
In 1995 the bank reported net earnings of $896,000 or $0.38 per share for the fourth quarter and $4.8 million or $2.04 per share for the year.

The bank attributed its expected earnings increase to higher core operating income, a substantial gain from the sale of its Brookfield and Bethel branches and a higher level of income in 1996 not subject to tax.
